resources.name: Bucket
resources.description: A bucket (called UsageVolumProduct in the SID Model) represents and tracks a quantity of usage (remaining or consumed). It could be either a quantity or an amount in a currency. It can represent a fixed number of SMS,MMS, call minutes, quantity of data and so on

fields.name: confirmationDate
fields.description: Date when the deduction was confirmed in the server

fields.name: description
fields.description: Text describing the contents of the balance managed by the bucket

fields.name: isShared
fields.description: True if the bucket is shared between several devices or users

fields.name: name
fields.description: Friendly name to identify the bucket

fields.name: remainingValueName
fields.description: Remaining amount in a formatted string for the bucket given in the balance unit (for example 1.9 Gb). This formatted string could be used for display needs for example

fields.name: requestedDate
fields.description: Date when the deduction request was received in the server

fields.name: status
fields.description: status for the bucket. active, expired, suspended

fields.name: usageType
fields.description: defines the type of the underlying Balance eg data,voice, any currency eg EUR, USD etc

flattenedRefs.name: partyAccount
flattenedRefs.description: A reference to the account that owns the bucket

flattenedRefs.name: remainingValue
flattenedRefs.description: Indicate the amount on the bucket

flattenedRefs.name: reservedValue
flattenedRefs.description: Indicate the amount reserved on the bucket

flattenedRefs.name: validFor
flattenedRefs.description: The period for which the balance in the bucket is valid

subResources.description: reference to the LogicalResource eg MSISDN

resources.name: TopupBalance
resources.description: Represents a detailed description of a recharge operation requested over a bucket (defined by a specific product or reference to a product (i.e.: a commercial id such as an msisidn) and a service type)

fields.name: confirmationDate
fields.description: Date when the deduction was confirmed in the server

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of the recharge operation

fields.name: isAutoTopup
fields.description: Indicates if the topup requested is an autotopup (to be processed periodically)

fields.name: numberOfPeriods
fields.description: For autotopup indicates the number of occurrences of the period the recharge operation must be executed. If not included then no limit is set to stop the executionof the topup every period

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Text describing the reason for the action/task

fields.name: requestedDate
fields.description: Date when the deduction request was received in the server

fields.name: voucher
fields.description: Identifier for a voucher when the topup can be performed by this means

fields.name: recurringPeriod
fields.description: For autotopup indicates the periodicity for the recharge operation (monthly, weekly, )

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the operation

fields.name: usageType
fields.description: defines the type of the underlying Balance eg data,voice, any currency eg EUR, USD etc

flattenedRefs.name: amount
flattenedRefs.description: Indicate the amount on the bucket

flattenedRefs.name: channel
flattenedRefs.description: Indicator for the channel used to request the transfer operation. Structure including at least attribute name

flattenedRefs.name: partyAccount
flattenedRefs.description: A reference to the account that owns the bucket impacted by the balance related operation

flattenedRefs.name: paymentMethod
flattenedRefs.description: Payment method used for the recharge operation (e.g.: cash, credit card). Structure including at least attribute dname. Notice that the use of a voucher can be managed as a specific methodtype, where he voucher code can be passed as value.

flattenedRefs.name: requestor
flattenedRefs.description: Identifier for the user/customer/entity that performs the top-up action. This can be used to indicate the identifier of an agent that performs the operation on behalf of a user via a customer service channel. Structure including at least attributes role and name.

flattenedRefs.name: validFor
flattenedRefs.description: The period for which the balance in the bucket is valid

resourceRefs.name: bucket
resourceRefs.description: A reference to the bucket impacted by the request or the value itself.

resources.description: The TransferBalance resource is a detailed description of credit transfer operation requested between two buckets (reference to products owned by customers and consuming credit when using a service).
